name: sammati-plugins
description: Claude plugins from Sammati, a consent management and privacy compliance platform built for India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025.

plugins.name: sammati-dpdp
plugins.description: DPDP compliance readiness assessment and gap analysis for India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and DPDP Rules, 2025: a readiness score, your data protection, privacy and consent gaps, and a prioritised action list, from a short assessment or a review of your privacy notice. For startups, SaaS, fintech, Data Fiduciaries and DPOs.
